req.title: Return PATCH request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to PATCH /patch with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that PATCH /patch returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, and origin. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — plain PATCH with no body returns all required keys with correct status; (2) positive EP — PATCH with JSON body reflects json field correctly; (3) positive EP — PATCH with form data reflects form field; (4) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (GET) on /patch returns 405; (5) boundary BVA — PATCH with empty body yields data='' and json=null; (6) DT — PATCH with query string reflects args field exactly; (7) NEG — PATCH with invalid Content-Type for JSON body yields json=null. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_patch_returns_200_and_required_keys
expected: JSON body contains keys: url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — statement: respond to PATCH /patch with JSON including url, args, headers, form, data, files, json and origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_returns_200_and_required_keys():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'):
        assert key in body, f'Missing key: {key}'

test_patch_returns_200_and_required_keys()

tests.name: test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with Content-Type: application/json and body {"key": "value"}
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — json field must reflect parsed JSON payload
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field():
    payload = '{"key": "value"}'
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=payload,
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] == {'key': 'value'}
    assert body['data'] == '{"key": "value"}'

test_patch_with_json_body_reflects_json_field()

tests.name: test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with application/x-www-form-urlencoded body field=hello
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — form field must reflect URL-encoded form payload
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field():
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data={'field': 'hello'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['form'] == {'field': 'hello'}
    assert body['json'] is None

test_patch_with_form_data_reflects_form_field()

tests.name: test_patch_with_query_string_reflects_args_field
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — args field must reflect query string parameters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_patch_with_query_string_reflects_args_field():

tests.name: test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json
actions: Send PATCH /patch with explicitly empty body (Content-Length: 0)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — boundary: zero-length body; data must be empty string, json must be null
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json():
    r = client.patch('/patch', data=b'', content_type='application/octet-stream')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['data'] == ''
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['form'] == {}

test_patch_empty_body_yields_empty_data_and_null_json()

tests.name: test_patch_invalid_json_content_type_yields_null_json_field
actions: Send PATCH /patch with Content-Type: application/json but malformed body 'not-json'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — error pathway: malformed JSON body must not crash; json field must be null
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_invalid_json_content_type_yields_null_json_field():
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        data=b'not-json',
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert body['json'] is None
    assert body['data'] == 'not-json'

tests.name: test_patch_response_contains_exactly_required_top_level_keys
actions: Inspect top-level keys of JSON response
expected: Exactly the keys url, args, headers, form, data, files, json, origin are present — no more, no fewer
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — statement enumerates exactly 8 keys; boundary: key set must match exactly
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_response_contains_exactly_required_top_level_keys():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    expected_keys = {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'form', 'data', 'files', 'json', 'origin'}
    assert set(body.keys()) == expected_keys

test_patch_response_contains_exactly_required_top_level_keys()

tests.name: test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path
trace: R-HTTPBIN-008 — url field must reflect the request URL; catches mutations that swap url with another field
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path():
    r = client.patch('/patch')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.get_json()
    assert isinstance(body['url'], str)
    assert body['url'].endswith('/patch')

test_patch_url_field_contains_patch_path()
